episodes.name: The Collywobbles
episodes.overviewEn: Amanda Waller assembles the Creature Commandos -- led by General Rick Flag Sr. -- and sends them to Pokolistan to protect Princess Ilana Rostovic.

episodes.name: The Tourmaline Necklace
episodes.overviewEn: As Ilana continues her pursuit of Flag, The Bride shows Nina where she was created -- and relives Frankenstein's rocky attempts to woo her.

episodes.name: Cheers to the Tin Man
episodes.overviewEn: As the Creature Commandos attempt to save The Bride and Nina, GI Robot relives his glory days -- and finally gets his wish.

episodes.name: Chasing Squirrels
episodes.overviewEn: The Creature Commandos return home to understand Circe's motivation, while Weasel reflects on the events that landed him in Belle Reve.

episodes.name: The Iron Pot
episodes.overviewEn: Frankenstein is nursed to health by a new friend. Later, Flag and Frankenstein team up to disprove Circe's visions about the Princess.

episodes.name: Priyatel Skelet
episodes.overviewEn: As Dr. Phosphorus is born of his own research, the Creature Commandos find themselves on the eve of destruction.

episodes.name: A Very Funny Monster
episodes.overviewEn: Nina's birth proves unexpectedly complicated, while the Princess attempts to escape death at the hands of the Creature Commandos once and for all.
